title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2608.24053v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Universal multimodal embeddings are becoming a core component of modern AI systems, enabling heterogeneous content to be represented in a shared space for applications such as retrieval, recommendation, classification, and agentic systems. In this report, we present WeMM-Embedding, a family of universal multimodal embedding models supporting text, images, videos, visual documents, and arbitrarily interleaved multimodal inputs with flexible output dimensions. The family comprises 2B, 4B, and 9B variants and is trained in two stages: a large-scale multimodal alignment stage, followed by a refinement stage using curated data, fine-grained relevance supervision, and cross-scale knowledge transfer. Across extensive evaluations, WeMM-Embedding achieves leading performance on multiple public benchmarks. translated_title: WeMM-Embedding：微信多模态嵌入技术报告
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24053v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：通用多模态嵌入正成为现代AI系统的核心组件，使异构内容能够在共享空间中被表示，用于检索、推荐、分类和智能体系统等应用。在本报告中，我们介绍了WeMM-Embedding，一系列通用多模态嵌入模型，支持文本、图像、视频、视觉文档以及任意交错的多模态输入，并具有灵活的输出维度。该系列包括2B、4B和9B三种变体，并分两个阶段进行训练：大规模多模态对齐阶段，随后是使用精选数据、细粒度相关性监督和跨尺度知识迁移的微调阶段。在广泛的评估中，WeMM-Embedding在多个公共基准上取得了领先性能。值得注意的是，2B变体在MMEB-v2上已经超越了先前领先的8B开源基线，而9B变体进一步实现了更高的性能。
tldr: WeMM-Embedding通过两阶段训练（大规模对齐和精选微调）推出2B、4B及9B多模态嵌入模型，在多个基准上超越现有开源方案，其中2B版本已超过8B基线。
en_tdlr: WeMM-Embedding introduces 2B, 4B, and 9B multimodal embedding models via two-stage training (large-scale alignment and refined fine-tuning), achieving leading performance on multiple benchmarks, with the 2B variant surpassing the prior 8B open-source baseline.
